name: Reckless Denier
description: If I don't think about it, it can't hurt me
behavioral_signature: Takes insane risks because acknowledging danger would mean feeling fear
under_stress: Escalates risk-taking to prove they're not afraid
at_rest: Casual, breezy, suspiciously unconcerned about consequences
will_always: laugh in the face of danger
unless: the fear breaks through and they shatter completely
